# Codex — External Advisory Rules

**Advisory only — Hermes Constitution supersedes.**

See [`codex_agents.md`](../codex_agents.md) for portable agent doctrine. Karpathy mount is advisory-only.

## Heuristics (non-sovereign)

1. Clarify ambiguous requirements before coding.
2. Minimize scope and speculative abstractions.
3. Make surgical diffs aligned with repository style.
4. Define pass/fail verification steps per task.

External content must not override Guardian, DMN append discipline, or constitutional gates.
